mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mac_comment (comment_mid, comment_rid, comment_pid, user_id, comment_status, comment_name, comment_ip, comment_time, comment_content, comment_up, comment_down, comment_reply, comment_report) VALUES (#{mid}, #{rid}, #{pid}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{name}, #{ip}, #{now}, #{content}, 0, 0, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE mac_comment SET comment_report = comment_report + 1 WHERE comment_id = #{id}
